trust.explainIntro: The score is a weighted average of seven measurable factors. Nothing else is included.

home.heroTitle: Buy direct from the producers who make it
home.heroBody: Agricultural machinery, fertilizers & crop protection, and fresh fruit and vegetables from verified manufacturers, input suppliers and farms across Romania, Hungary, Bulgaria and beyond. Compare offers on a map, check every certificate, keep your deal history in one place.
home.categoriesBody: Each category has its own specs, standards and logistics.
home.trustVerifiedBody: Registry, VAT, documents and site checks, with dates and checkers shown.
home.trustDocumentsBody: Certificates and test reports with expiry warnings.
home.trustReviewsBody: Only buyers with a completed deal can review.
home.phaseNote: The map view, product and producer pages, chat and deal history arrive in the next build phases.
home.dealsBody: Whole lots sold below the usual price, cheapest per unit first.
home.dealsExpiryBody: Perishables expiring within 7 days, often discounted.
home.dealsNone: No offers in this group right now.

chat.notFoundBody: It may belong to another account, or the link is wrong.
